title: Add discount field to Product
description: As a product manager, I want to add a discount percentage field to each product so that we can run promotional pricing. The discount should be stored as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0) and returned in the API response.
acceptance_criteria: Product entity has a new field: discount (BigDecimal, nullable, between 0.0 and 1.0)
GET /api/products returns the discount field in the response
POST /api/products accepts an optional discount field
PUT /api/products/{id} allows updating the discount field
Frontend product detail page displays the discount percentage (e.g., '15% off')
Unit tests cover the new field
affected_area: Product entity, repository, service, controller, frontend detail view
